pictures.author: Leeluv
pictures.observations: Entire960x642 gateway view inspected. Tall white stone unroofed Lingxing frame with double beams, rounded/lotus post finials and broad curling ornaments; true open threshold and stone steps, red enclosure wall and bright yellow curved barrel-tile coping. Axial pale path and aligned terrace stairs behind. Fine carved narratives are simplified.

pictures.author: Ivan Walsh
pictures.observations: Entire960x745 hall-court view inspected. White stone gateway in red/yellow-capped wall, open red doors, stone entry steps; a broad yellow hipped hall roof, red facade, blue/green painted beams, four small polygonal upper windows and a deep central doorway. Exact subsidiary wing facades are not resolved.

pictures.observations: Entire wide1020x428 altar image inspected to resolve the main platform. Plain square yellow/orange brick terrace faces, broad pale stone cap and corner dressings, stone stairs with solid sloping cheeks, open paved top, dark square ritual vessel and a round vessel on pale pedestals. No continuous terrace balustrade is inferred. Individual vessel positions/counts and exact masonry inventory are approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Temple of Earth ceremonial core: two-tier square yellow-brick Fangze altar with pale stone coping/corner dressings, four aligned stairways per tier, square red enclosures with yellow tile coping and open white stone Lingxing gateways, axial approaches and original simplified bronze ritual vessels. Include the mapped southern Huangqi hall court with yellow hipped roofs, red facade, open central doorway, painted beam trim and flanking L-shaped wings. Larger Ditan Park, the distant entrance paifang, gardens and other park compounds remain host context. Internal allocations, terrace/wall heights, gate/vessel inventory and carving are approximate exterior visualization.
